purpose: Release inventory of existing session policy; not a replacement for player preferences

retroarch.controllerPorts: from admitted game and assigned lobby seats
retroarch.network: existing direct or public relay route selected by the session
retroarch.contentAndCoreIdentity: verified on deliberate admission, never inferred from player count

ppsspp.MAC: keep the player's existing console identity; never distribute one shared MAC
ppsspp.serverAndRole: generated for the accepted invitation, never copied from the build device

nativeBundles.python: recreate environments from offline locked wheels; verify interpreter compatibility
nativeBundles.firmware: user import through Game Preparation; unavailable firmware leaves the route unavailable

remotePlay.signaling: Fluxer invitations and existing lightweight directory
remotePlay.limitation: some networks cannot connect directly; same-router checks do not prove different-network play

notDeliveredByCollection: new multiplayer support for an unadmitted game
automatic migration of existing unmanaged emulator installations
